simulation_scope: Real QSPI boot, 2 x 83 selfchecks, 2 full-reference NPU inferences, 256 UART bytes, GPIO output and rising/falling IRQ, invalid command
simulation_difference: Same jury C source; JURY_SIM sets CPB=50 instead of CPB=434 to accelerate serial simulation
changes: Separate jury firmware, linker script, 8KB-loading boot ROM, existing single-USB FPGA wrapper. ASIC functional RTL unchanged.
limitations: Behavioral RTL simulation is not a physical board run or ASIC timing proof. DRC warnings are retained in drc.rpt.
physical_board_scope: 21 inferences + 2 selftests + manual GPIO on 5 September build; distinct from d45 ASIC
